role: Observation ingestion write path for Co-Being knowledge graph, carrying structured observations from Layer 2 (Perception) into Layer 3 (Knowledge Graph).
detail: Core module implementing the ingestion pipeline for observations. Defines two main dataclasses: IngestionResult (node_id, is_new, confidence, confirmation_count, similarity_event, prediction_check) and ObservationSession (session_id, node_id, started_at). Main async function add_observation handles new detections (candidate_node_id=None) and repeat detections (refresh confidence via D-TS-10 formula: new=min(1.0, current+(1.0-current)*0.1), increment confirmation_count, update last_confirmed). Optionally runs Epic 4 post-write hooks: similarity computation (compute_for_new_node) and expectation checking (check_prediction_error with update_expectations on confirmation). Also provides session management: create_observation_session and close_observation_session track camera-on periods with started_at/ended_at timestamps. All data carries SENSOR provenance (never omitted). Helper _find_instance_type queries INSTANCE_OF edges via query_edges; _refresh_confidence applies D-TS-10 formula; _build_instance_properties converts Observation fields to flat dict with bounding_box, embedding, dominant_colors. Backward-compatible design: Epic 4 hooks are optional (default None); omitting them produces pre-Epic-4 behavior.
gotchas: TYPE_CHECKING guard imports SimilarityComputer/ExpectationManager only for annotation to avoid circular imports. _find_instance_type gracefully returns None if query_edges unavailable (duck-type check with hasattr). add_observation treats stale candidate_node_id as new node (graceful fallback, no crash). close_observation_session is safe no-op if session_node not found. confirmation_count starts at 0 for new nodes, incremented by 1 on each repeat detection.
